provenance.fold_rule: first 4 bytes of sha256("fold:" + id) mod 5
provenance.method: dimension prior: smoothed odds of a candidate being the cause against the overall odds; calibration: isotonic regression (pool adjacent violators) on the summed log-odds with smoothed block rates
provenance.selection_rule: start from the shipped model and walk the others in order; one replaces the best so far only if its out-of-fold Brier over the rankings that print a probability is at least 2 percent lower and its out-of-fold MRR is not lower

reversed.note: the same pairs with green and red swapped; labels mean nothing here, so only label-free facts are kept
